selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main topic is introduced in this passage?
questions.answer: It introduces the wisdom behind why the five daily prayers are tied to specific times.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does each prayer time mark in the world?
questions.answer: Each one marks the beginning of a major change or turning point.

questions.question: Besides marking a change, what else does each prayer time reflect?
questions.answer: It reflects Allah’s power at work and His widespread blessings.

questions.question: Why are glorifying and praising Allah especially fitting at these times?
questions.answer: Because these times gather many blessings and show Allah’s power clearly, so they call for extra praise, thanks, and glorification.

questions.question: What does the passage say is the meaning of the prescribed prayers?
questions.answer: They are acts of glorifying Allah, praising Him, and thanking Him.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the role of countless blessings between one prayer time and the next?
questions.answer: It says those blessings build up between the prayer times and are met with gratitude in prayer.

questions.question: What does the speaker promise to explain about the wisdom of prayer times?
questions.answer: He says he will explain only one example out of many.

questions.question: What does the speaker ask the listener to do in order to understand this meaning better?
questions.answer: He asks the listener to pay close attention along with his own lower self to the five points that will follow.

questions.question: What can we infer about the wisdom of prayer times from the phrase that only one instance will be explained?
questions.answer: We can infer that the wisdom is deep and has many layers, not just one simple reason.

questions.question: Who is being addressed in the passage, and what does that show about the tone?
questions.answer: A brother is being addressed, which gives the passage a personal, caring, and direct tone.

questions.question: What question is being answered in this section?
questions.answer: It is answering why the five daily prayers are set at certain times.

questions.question: How are the times of prayer connected to major events or changes?
questions.answer: Each prayer time is linked to the start of an important shift or transition.

questions.question: What do the prayer times show about Allah’s actions in creation?
questions.answer: They show His management, power, and blessings throughout the universe.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is there more need for thanks at these times?
questions.answer: Because many blessings have been received and gathered by then.

questions.question: What three responses to Allah are emphasized in the passage?
questions.answer: Glorifying Him, praising Him, and thanking Him.

questions.question: How does the passage connect prayer with awareness of blessings?
questions.answer: It presents prayer as the right response to the blessings that continue to come between the appointed times.

questions.question: What does the description of the meaning as “subtle and profound” suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that the wisdom of prayer times is meaningful, rich, and not obvious to everyone at first.

questions.question: Why does the speaker mention listening together with his own nafs?
questions.answer: It shows humility and suggests that both the listener and the speaker need the reminder.

questions.question: What Qur’anic theme appears at the beginning of the passage before the explanation starts?
questions.answer: It highlights glorifying and praising Allah at different parts of the day.

questions.question: How does that opening theme connect to the subject of prayer times?
questions.answer: It supports the idea that certain times of day are especially appropriate for remembering, praising, and glorifying Allah.

questions.question: What is one reason given for assigning prayers to specified times instead of leaving them completely open?
questions.answer: Specific times match important transitions and make people notice Allah’s power and blessings.

questions.question: What does the passage say each prayer time is a mirror to?
questions.answer: It is a mirror to divine power in action and to universal blessings.

questions.question: What is meant by the blessings being “accumulated” between prayer times?
questions.answer: It means blessings keep coming and piling up until the next prayer becomes a moment to thank Allah for them.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the relationship between prayer and gratitude?
questions.answer: Prayer is a way of expressing gratitude for the many blessings Allah gives.
